title: Printing Press
description: Gutenberg invented the movable-type printing press in Europe, revolutionising information sharing.

title: Columbus Reaches Americas
description: Christopher Columbus landed in the Bahamas, initiating European exploration of the Americas.

title: Magna Carta Signed
description: King John sealed the Magna Carta at Runnymede, limiting royal power and establishing legal principles.

title: Fall of Western Rome
description: The Western Roman Empire fell when Germanic leader Odoacer deposed Emperor Romulus Augustulus.

title: Battle of Hastings
description: William the Conqueror defeated King Harold II, changing the course of English history.

title: Declaration of Independence
description: The thirteen American colonies declared independence from Britain, forming the United States.

title: French Revolution Begins
description: The storming of the Bastille ignited a decade of radical social and political upheaval in France.

title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the lunar surface.

title: World War I Begins
description: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand triggered a global conflict involving major world powers.

title: World War II Ends
description: Germany and Japan surrendered, ending the deadliest conflict in human history.

title: Sputnik Launched
description: The Soviet Union launched the first artificial satellite, sparking the space race.

title: Penicillin Discovered
description: Alexander Fleming discovered the antibiotic properties of penicillin, revolutionising medicine.

title: DNA Structure Discovered
description: Watson and Crick revealed the double helix structure of DNA, transforming biology.

title: First Airplane Flight
description: The Wright brothers achieved the first powered, sustained, and controlled airplane flight.

title: Theory of Relativity
description: Albert Einstein published his special theory of relativity, fundamentally changing physics.

title: Fall of Berlin Wall
description: The Berlin Wall fell, symbolising the end of the Cold War and division of Europe.

title: First Modern Olympics
description: The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, reviving the ancient tradition.

title: Titanic Sinks
description: The RMS Titanic struck an iceberg and sank on its maiden voyage, killing over 1,500 people.

title: First iPhone Released
description: Apple introduced the iPhone, revolutionising the smartphone industry and mobile computing.

title: General Relativity
description: Einstein completed his general theory of relativity, describing gravity as spacetime curvature.

title: Great Depression Begins
description: The Wall Street Crash triggered a worldwide economic depression lasting through the 1930s.

title: Womens Suffrage in US
description: The 19th Amendment granted American women the constitutional right to vote.

title: First Heart Transplant
description: Dr. Christiaan Barnard performed the first human-to-human heart transplant in South Africa.

title: Woodstock Festival
description: The iconic music festival drew over 400,000 people to a dairy farm in New York.

title: Star Wars Released
description: George Lucas launched one of the most successful film franchises in cinema history.

title: World Wide Web Launched
description: Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web to the public, transforming global communication.

title: Human Genome Project Begins
description: An international effort to map all human genes launched, revolutionising genetics and medicine.

title: Dolly the Sheep Cloned
description: Dolly became the first mammal cloned from an adult somatic cell, a breakthrough in genetics.

title: Civil Rights Act Passed
description: The landmark US law outlawed discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, or national origin.

title: First Mars Rover Landing
description: NASAs Pathfinder mission delivered Sojourner, the first successful Mars rover.

title: Eiffel Tower Completed
description: Gustave Eiffels iconic tower opened as the centrepiece of the 1889 Worlds Fair in Paris.

title: First Grammy Awards
description: The inaugural Grammy Awards ceremony honoured musical achievements from 1958.

title: Beatles on Ed Sullivan
description: The Beatles made their legendary US television debut, marking the British Invasion.

title: First Academy Awards
description: The first Oscars ceremony honoured films from 1927 and 1928 in a 15-minute event.

title: First Super Bowl
description: The Green Bay Packers won the first AFL-NFL World Championship Game, later called the Super Bowl.

title: First Modern Bicycle
description: John Kemp Starley unveiled the Rover Safety Bicycle, the first modern bicycle design.

title: Berlin Wall Built
description: East Germany began constructing the Berlin Wall, dividing the city and symbolising Cold War tensions.

title: First Test-Tube Baby
description: Louise Brown, the first baby conceived through IVF, was born in England.

title: First Transistor Invented
description: Bardeen, Brattain, and Shockley invented the transistor at Bell Labs, founding modern electronics.

title: First Woman in Space
description: Valentina Tereshkova became the first woman to fly in space aboard Vostok 6.

title: US Constitution Signed
description: The Philadelphia Convention signed the US Constitution, establishing the framework of American government.

title: Smallpox Vaccine Developed
description: Edward Jenner developed the first successful vaccine, using cowpox to prevent smallpox.

title: First Subway Opens
description: The London Underground opened as the worlds first underground railway system.

title: First Radio Transmission
description: Guglielmo Marconi transmitted the first wireless radio signal, pioneering long-distance communication.

title: X-Rays Discovered
description: Wilhelm Röntgen discovered X-rays, revolutionising medical imaging and diagnosis.

title: Pluto Reclassified
description: The IAU reclassified Pluto as a dwarf planet, changing the definition of a planet.

title: Soviet Union Dissolved
description: The Soviet Union officially dissolved, ending the Cold War and creating 15 independent republics.

title: Jesse Owens Wins Gold
description: Jesse Owens won four gold medals at the Berlin Olympics, disproving Nazi racial ideology.

title: Live Aid Concert
description: Bob Geldof organised simultaneous concerts in London and Philadelphia to raise funds for Ethiopian famine relief.

title: Nevermind Released
description: Nirvana released Nevermind, bringing grunge and alternative rock into the mainstream.

title: Telephone Patented
description: Alexander Graham Bell patented the telephone, revolutionising voice communication.

title: First Motion Picture
description: The Lumière brothers held the first public screening of a motion picture in Paris.

title: ENIAC Computer Built
description: The first general-purpose electronic digital computer, ENIAC, was completed in the United States.

title: South Africa First Free Election
description: Nelson Mandela became the first black president after apartheid-era elections.

title: Hubble Telescope Launched
description: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched, providing unprecedented views of the universe.

title: First McDonald Opens
description: Richard and Maurice McDonald opened the first McDonald's restaurant in San Bernardino, California.

title: Thriller Released
description: Michael Jackson released Thriller, which became the best-selling album of all time.

title: First Space Shuttle Flight
description: Space Shuttle Columbia launched on STS-1, the first orbital flight of the Space Shuttle program.

title: US Civil War Ends
description: Confederate General Robert E. Lee surrendered to Union General Ulysses S. Grant, ending the Civil War.

title: First Microprocessor
description: Intels 4004 became the first commercially available microprocessor, ushering in the computing age.

title: Battle of Waterloo
description: Napoleon Bonaparte was defeated by a coalition of European armies, ending his rule.

title: First Automobile
description: Karl Benz patented the first gasoline-powered automobile, the Benz Patent-Motorwagen.

title: MTV Launches
description: MTV began broadcasting, transforming the music industry with the concept of music videos.

title: Gone With the Wind Released
description: The epic historical romance became one of the highest-grossing and most iconic films in cinema.

title: International Space Station Begins
description: The first module of the ISS was launched, beginning the largest international space collaboration.

title: First Womens World Cup
description: The first FIFA Womens World Cup was held in China, won by the United States.

title: COVID-19 Pandemic Declared
description: The WHO declared COVID-19 a global pandemic, leading to worldwide lockdowns and health crises.

title: Light Bulb Patented
description: Thomas Edison patented a practical incandescent light bulb, illuminating the modern world.

title: First Television Demonstrated
description: Philo Farnsworth successfully demonstrated the first fully electronic television system.

title: Barcelona Olympics
description: The Summer Olympics in Barcelona were the first without a boycott since 1972.

title: Pepsi-Cola Created
description: Caleb Bradham created Pepsi-Cola in New Bern, North Carolina, as a digestive aid.

title: Hamlet Published
description: William Shakespeare wrote Hamlet, one of the most influential works in English literature.

title: First Blood Transfusion
description: British obstetrician James Blundell performed the first successful human blood transfusion.

title: Insulin Discovered
description: Banting and Best isolated insulin at the University of Toronto, transforming diabetes treatment.

title: First Spacewalk
description: Alexei Leonov became the first person to conduct a spacewalk, lasting 12 minutes.

title: Beethovens 5th Premieres
description: Beethovens Symphony No. 5 premiered in Vienna, becoming one of the most recognisable pieces in classical music.

title: First Tour de France
description: The first Tour de France cycling race was held, covering six stages over 2,428 kilometres.

title: Emancipation Proclamation
description: President Lincoln declared slaves in Confederate states free, shifting the Civil War aims.

title: Snow White Released
description: Disneys Snow White became the first full-length cel-animated feature film in history.

title: Jurassic Park Released
description: Steven Spielbergs dinosaur blockbuster revolutionised visual effects with CGI creatures.

title: First Scuba Gear
description: Jacques Cousteau and Émile Gagnan developed the Aqua-Lung, the first modern scuba diving equipment.

title: Taj Mahal Completed
description: The Taj Mahal was completed in Agra, built by Emperor Shah Jahan as a mausoleum for his wife.

title: First Nobel Prizes
description: The first Nobel Prizes were awarded in Stockholm in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, and peace.

title: Panama Canal Opens
description: The Panama Canal opened, connecting the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans and transforming global trade.

title: First Hot Air Balloon Flight
description: The Montgolfier brothers launched the first manned hot air balloon flight in Paris.

title: First Computer Mouse
description: Douglas Engelbart invented the first computer mouse, a wooden shell with two metal wheels.

title: First Photograph Taken
description: Joseph Nicéphore Niépce captured the earliest known permanent photograph using a camera obscura.

title: Radium Discovered
description: Marie and Pierre Curie discovered radium, advancing the understanding of radioactivity.

title: Polio Vaccine Announced
description: Dr. Jonas Salk announced the successful polio vaccine, nearly eradicating the disease worldwide.

title: Canadian Confederation
description: The British North America Act united three colonies into the Dominion of Canada.

title: Avatar Released
description: James Camerons Avatar became the highest-grossing film of all time using groundbreaking 3D technology.

title: Usain Bolt Triple Gold
description: Usain Bolt won three gold medals at the Beijing Olympics with world records in all three events.

title: Phelps Eight Golds
description: Michael Phelps won eight gold medals at the Beijing Olympics, the most by any athlete in a single Games.

title: Google Founded
description: Larry Page and Sergey Brin founded Google in a garage, revolutionising internet search.

title: Facebook Launched
description: Mark Zuckerberg launched Facebook from his Harvard dormitory, creating the largest social network.

title: YouTube Founded
description: Three former PayPal employees founded YouTube, transforming video sharing and online content.

title: Citizen Kane Released
description: Orson Welles released Citizen Kane, widely regarded as one of the greatest films ever made.

title: First Vaccine Created
description: Edward Jenner administered the first smallpox vaccine, founding the science of immunology.

title: Elvis First Record
description: Elvis Presley released That All Right, marking the dawn of rock and roll music.

title: First Video Game Console
description: Magnavox released the Odyssey, the first home video game console, featuring table tennis.
